html.body: Date: 2025-03-03 REMARKSObjections to the Drawings The drawings were objected to under 37 CFR 1.83(a) for failing to show the features of claim 6.While Applicant does not necessarily agree, solely in an effort to expedite prosecution, claim 6 has been cancelled. Therefore, withdrawal of the objection to the drawings is respectfully requested.Rejections under 35 U.S.C. § 112 Claim 6 was rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 112(a) as failing to comply with the written description requirement.While Applicant does not necessarily agree, solely in an effort to expedite prosecution, claim 6 has been cancelled. Therefore, withdrawal of the 35 U.S.C. § 112(a) rejections is respectfully requested.Rejections under 35 U.S.C. § 103 Claims 1-2 and 5 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as being unpatentable over Combes (FR 2917713 A1).In addition to the foregoing, claims 3-4 were objected to as being dependent upon a rejected base claim, but were indicated as allowable if rewritten in independent form including all of the limitations of the base claim and any intervening claims. Applicant thanks the Examiner for the indication of allowable subject matter.Returning to the rejections, while Applicant does not necessarily agree, solely in an effort to expedite prosecution, claim 1 has been amended to include the features of claim 3. In view of the indication that claim 3 would be allowable if rewritten in independent form, Applicant submits that claim 1 is not allowable. Those claims that depend therefrom or refer thereto should be allowable as well.Conclusion Applicant therefore respectfully submits that all of the claims of the application are allowable and thus requests that the Examiner indicate all of the claims as allowed and pass the application to allowance.The amendments to the claims were done merely to expedite prosecution of the present case. Applicant reserves any and all rights to pursue the subject matter of the original claims in this application, or in another application. Moreover, these amendments should not be construed as an admission or acquiescence to any rejection.Furthermore, the fact that Applicant has only addressed certain rejections should not be considered to be acquiescence to the rejections. Rather, Applicant has presented the argument herein in an effort to expedite prosecution. Applicant reserves any and all rights to address any rejection made but not specifically addressed herein.The Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge any additional fees which may be required to this application under 37 C.F.R. §§ 1.16-1.17, or credit any overpayment, to Deposit Account No. 07-2069.Should the Examiner discover there are remaining issues which may be resolved by a telephone interview, the Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned attorney at (312) 987-2927.Respectfully submitted, GREER, BURNS & CRAIN, LTD./PATRICK J. SMITH/By Patrick J. Smith Registration No. 65,626 3 March 2025 200 West Madison Street, Suite 2100 Chicago, Illinois 60606 Main: (312) 360-0080 Direct: (312) 987-2927 Customer No. 24978
